summary: Policy-aware content snapshots for claimed typed object rows (cinatra#1430, epic #1424). Adds the object_content_snapshots keying table so a typed object row becomes context-pinnable: capture mints an immutable JSON snapshot of the row's normalized data as a real representation revision over a real blob resource, and this table content-addresses it by its full policy key (org_id, object_id, content_digest, effective_base_type, snapshot_schema_version, claim_disposition_fingerprint) with a UNIQUE index. The key drives reuse-vs-mint: identical content re-pinned under the same claim/disposition reuses the existing representation revision; a data change (new content_digest) or a claimant change (new claim_disposition_fingerprint) mints a fresh snapshot — a new claimant never reuses another claimant's snapshot. Gate class destructive — though the DATABASE change is purely additive (a brand-new table + three indexes; no NOT NULL on existing data, no unique index on an existing table, no retype, no tightened constraint, no data rewrite): the classification comes from the SAME PR moving the run_context_selections bootstrap CREATE-DDL text out of drizzle-store.ts into the artifact-claim-schema.ts pure-strings leaf (byte-identical DDL, spread back into buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries; the file-size-ratchet extract-leaf pattern), which the gate's single-file matcher reads as table-removed-from-ddl. The deployed run_context_selections table is untouched — no DDL executes against it; up() creates only object_content_snapshots. Mirrors the idempotent bootstrap DDL in src/lib/drizzle-store.ts (buildCreateStoreSchemaQueries) so fresh-bootstrap and operator-upgrade stay aligned (core__0034/0041/0043 precedent). down() drops the keying table only (the representation/resource/artifact_blobs substance a snapshot minted is append-only and reclaims through the resource GC when unpinned). SEQ IS PROVISIONAL: assigned at merge; shipped max is 0043, 0044 is claimed by open PR #1384, and a concurrent lane may also claim 0045 — renumber-at-merge is normal.
